checks: The history driver consumes process.argv.slice(2) as request path/hash/deadline. Node consumes the new V8 option before script execution; it does not add an application argument. The measured CLI invocation preserves the same program-argument parsing.

The history driver's prior() and kept() consumers read phase/runtime/plan/materialization/output hashes from driver results. They do not inspect supervisor.command or require a fixed supervisor result key set.

The publisher's phaseRecord/phaseOutput consumers read passed driver results, original authority, selected generation/root, staged Git state and the retained request.helper_sha256. The history helper remains a137 and the new supervisor flag changes none of those values.
The fixed history and document receipt collectors transport raw bytes and metadata. They do not parse or index supervisor.command.
The unchanged outer admission invokes PowerShell with InputManifest/InputSha256/TimeoutSeconds/MaxOwnedResidentMiB. Only its supervisor path and completed request hash need rebinding.

The supervisor resolves the history driver with PSScriptRoot and a fixed driver basename. Its own PSCommandPath is checked dynamically against manifest.supervisor_sha256; no own-basename check prevents the new filename in existing I.
The publisher pair imports the same a137 bytes already installed in I. Keeping this path unchanged avoids unnecessary publisher derivatives.
NODE_OPTIONS and NODE_PATH are removed by the existing supervisor before Node starts, preserving the explicit CLI bound. No execution, deadline, ownership or memory cap guard was removed.

actual_review_binding.supervisor_result_change: One additional node_semi_space_mib field and one additional option in command. Independent actual review should check this new exact order.
